name: Torrance Youth Council
org: City of Torrance Community Services Department
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on youth issues. Members run Holiday Boutiques to raise money, a Beat the Odds scholarship and Youth Forum Day. They also help at city events.
who_can_apply: Two members come from each Torrance high school, El Camino College and the California Academy of Math and Science. There are also two at-large members.
pay_detail: The page does not mention pay
duration: New members start in August. The page does not state a term length.
deadline_text: Applications are taken each May. New members start in August. May 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Ask staff about the May application. Call (310) 618-2935.
notes: Meetings are the first and third Wednesday at 7 p.m. at 3031 Torrance Blvd. They are open to the public, so you can visit before you apply.
